title: Tariff Footnote: The Appraisal Fee Taken Off a Revaluation Increase
content:
Footnote from the appraisal side to the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes tariff. What is taken off a revaluation increase for the appraisal fee depends on whether the programme credits its appraisal fee against the upgrade and on what is still owed on the report the revaluation rests on, as the Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services engagement for that report shows.

## The footnote

Where the programme credits its appraisal fee against the upgrade and the report the revaluation rests on carries nothing still owed, nothing is taken off. Where the programme credits its appraisal fee against the upgrade and that report carries an amount still owed, only the amount still owed is taken off. Where the programme does not credit its appraisal fee against the upgrade, the appraisal fee the programme publishes is taken off in full.

The report the revaluation rests on is the appraisal recorded against the registration, and the amount still owed is the balance due on that appraisal engagement.

## By programme

| Programme | Appraisal fee (USD) | Fee credited against the upgrade | Taken off a revaluation increase |
|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | 0 | no | the published fee, 0 |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | 125 | yes | the amount still owed on the report, or nothing where nothing is owed |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | 125 | yes | the amount still owed on the report, or nothing where nothing is owed |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | 175 | yes | the amount still owed on the report, or nothing where nothing is owed |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | 350 | yes | the amount still owed on the report, or nothing where nothing is owed |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | 275 | no | the published fee, 275 |

## Cases

- Under a programme that credits its fee, the report shows 40 USD still owed: 40 USD is taken off.
- Under a programme that credits its fee, the report shows nothing owed: nothing is taken off.
- Under the Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme, whatever the report shows, 275 USD is taken off.
